title: limonium fallax
intro: Limonium fallax, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region, characterized by its delicate purple flowers and fragrant foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Limonium fallax include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy for stress relief. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
